problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$

activity_context.topic_title: Linear Combinations of Vectors in N-Dimensional Euclidean Space
